name: php.restore
description: Rollback of php.remove on an apt host: reinstall a backup's exact package versions and restore its config, leaving the FPM service stopped and disabled as it was. It uses the newest backup unless one is named, fails if a recorded version is no longer available, and changes nothing when the packages are all still installed.

backup.description: Backup directory name; the newest when left out.

health_check: The helper confirms with dpkg that each package is at its recorded version.
